title: THE POWER-UPS ARE SHARED
why: His order of 2026-10-14: the party batch must work for both players. Each window rolled the drops for its own kills and kept its own pickups, so a coin that dropped for player 1 was only on player 1 screen and player 2 could not see it, never mind take it. A drop is now told to the other window over the pair channel the team combo already uses, so the same pickup lies on the floor in both. Whoever walks over it first takes it: the effect, the timer chip and the note are his own, and it disappears from the other window at once. The magnet still moves pickups in the window that owns the magnet only.
now: Power-up pickups now show in both windows, and either player can take one.
